ROOT.lessons: 1. Global spot scan (get_all_regions_spot_available) eliminates exploration overhead — massive win for diverse regions (5_regions: $110->$47). 2. Immediate ON_DEMAND fallback when all spots globally down beats any idle waiting — no-idle (G) outperforms 2-tick idle (D). 3. Sticky ON_DEMAND (condition2) hurts correlated-preemption scenarios — removing it fixes 2_zones_same regression. 4. Buffer-gated ON_DEMAND->SPOT return (buffer>=d + remaining_restart_overhead==0) prevents costly mid-startup switches. 5. All 6 test scenarios beat baseline: total savings $13.43/run average.
